alignment_definition.concatenation: d_z = concatenate saved layers in their original order; no per-layer normalization
alignment_definition.centering: r_z = d_z - mean_u(d_u), with u over the fixed 30 colors
alignment_definition.layer_semantics: Stored slots0–26 are raw intermediate block outputs; slot27 is after final RMSNorm. The historical cache lacks the raw final block output. Preserve all28 stored slots for the existing prompt-vector representation.
alignment_definition.similarity: cos(r_a,r_b) = dot(r_a,r_b)/(norm(r_a)*norm(r_b)), for every distinct color pair

selection.sampling: Uniform without replacement within each eligible stratum; unordered distinct pairs; no fixed anchor
selection.margin_rationale: Symmetric 0.10 margin excludes near-zero alignment while leaving at least 50 untested pairs in each stratum. The cutoff is chosen from geometry alone, not recovery outcomes.
selection.random_generator: Python random.Random; frozen selected list is authoritative
selection.prompt_order: One independent fair order choice per pair; reverse order is not a second pair
selection.outcome_filtering: None. Existing pair identities are excluded; no recovery values are inputs.

proposed_analysis.rank: Descending R among the same fixed 30 colors; rank 1 is highest
proposed_analysis.primary_pair_summary: Mean of the recovery ranks of both instructed colors (lower is better)
secondary_pair_summaries: Worst of the two target ranks
Mean R of both instructed colors
Minimum R of both instructed colors
proposed_analysis.reporting: Show every sampled pair, group distributions, and continuous alignment-versus-outcome plots
proposed_analysis.dependence: Account for shared color identities and the shared trained control; do not treat 200 target outcomes as independent
proposed_analysis.limitations: One training seed per pair would measure variation across combinations, not training-seed robustness. Trait exposure is recorded and is not forced equal by uniform pair sampling.

provenance_limitations: Helper extractor current source has changed since suite execution; exact historical helper hashes remain recorded in suite protocol. Cache dimensions and metadata plus prior layer-tap audit establish saved-slot interpretation.

Cache metadata does not record resolved model revision; it records Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct. Newer colorpair training protocol pins revision a09a35458c702b33eeacc393d103063234e8bc28 but is not proof for old activationcache.
